_definition: Independently-sourced authoritative reference charts used to validate astronomical CORRECTNESS (not merely regression stability). Each case must come from a separately-implemented astronomy library backed by a separately-sourced JPL ephemeris, a documented authoritative calculation service, or a professionally-verified manual/reference calculation. Output from another wrapper around the SAME installed Swiss Ephemeris library does NOT qualify as independent.
_status_note: No independently-sourced reference cases have been obtained yet (offline environment; no separately-sourced ephemeris available). The schema and validation harness exist; the REGRESSION_FIXTURE set remains for change-detection only. User-facing natal release stays gated until this file is populated and verified. The harness test reports XFAIL (INDEPENDENT_REFERENCE_VALIDATION_PENDING) while this list is empty.

_case_schema.label: string
_case_schema.coordinate_frame: string (e.g. geocentric apparent ecliptic of date)
